{{Top|leg}}
A '''Territorial Administrator''' was a position within the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Each Territorial Administrator was essentially the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of a territory within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and was responsible for increasing the profitability of their territory. Successful territorial managers could advance to positions at the [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] level. [[Odumin]] was a noted territorial manager within the system several years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
